data.name: Brunhilde
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German words ‘brun’ meaning ‘brown’ and ‘hild’ meaning ‘battle’, ‘Brunhilde’ means ‘strong-willed warrior woman’. In Norse mythology, she is the legendary Valkyrie who chooses fallen heroes to go to Valhalla.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of bravery, strength, and loyalty in the face of adversity.

in_greek.name: Βρουνχίλδη
in_greek.meaning: Greeks do not use this name, it is of Germanic origin,
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Βρουνχίλδη (Βρουνχίλδη, Βρουνκίλδη) είναι ένα Γερμανικό όνομα που επηρεάστηκε από τον Γερμανικό πολιτισμό, το όνομα προέρχεται από την Γερμανική λέξη ' Βρούν' (Brune) που σημαίνει 'Κόκκινο' και 'Χίλδη' (Hilde) που σημαίνει Γυναίκα. Δεν υπάρχει αναφορά σε αυτό το όνομα στο Νέο και Παλαιό Διατάγματα.

in_latin.name: Brunhilde
in_latin.long_meaning: Brunhilde, nomen Germanicum, ex Germanico originem habet. In Germanico lingua, Brunhilde significat virginem fortissimam aut potentem mulierem. Nomen Brunhilde est derivatum a duobus nominibus Germanicis, 'brun' quod significat rubeum aut rubrum, et 'hilde' quod significat pugna aut bellum. Brunhilde, in historia Germanica, fuit uxor regis Gunther. Nihilominus, Brunhilde non est nomen Christianum, sed potius Germanicum.

in_english.name: Brunhilde
in_english.meaning: Germanic origin, means strong or powerful woman,
in_english.long_meaning: Brunhilde is a Germanic name, derived from the German words 'brun' meaning red or brown, and 'hilde' meaning battle or fight. In Germanic mythology, Brunhilde was the wife of King Gunther. Although not a Christian name, Brunhilde has been used in various cultures as a symbol of strength and power. The name Brunhilde is not directly related to any biblical figure, but its meaning and connotation reflect the values of courage and resilience that are often associated with Christian virtues.

The name was popular among the Germanic cultures, notably in Norse mythology, and has been passed down through history.

By invoking Brunhilde's name, one can tap into this deep sense of unwavering determination, strength, and courage.
